cur:catacombs-arles-trinity-spouses.summary: Three tiers of richly carved figures – lid and two registers of the chest – surround a shell with the portraits of a married couple. The scenes include the creation of Adam and Eve by three figures (whence the name 'of the Trinity'), Christ's miracles and episodes of Peter. It is among the finest Roman imports at Arles.
facts: It was discovered in 1974 and measures 103 × 205 × 111 cm, according to the museum.
Like the Dogmatic Sarcophagus in the Vatican, it shows the creation scene with three similar figures, often read as the Trinity.
